title: Grothendieck group of finite projectives
statement: For a commutative ring $S$, $K_0(S)$ is the abelian group generated by symbols $[Q]$, one for each isomorphism class of finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module] $S$-modules $Q$, modulo the relations $[Q']+[Q'']=[Q'\oplus Q'']$ for all such $Q',Q''$. Explicitly, let $I_S$ be the set of isomorphism classes of quotients $S^n/N$ that are projective, where $n\in\mathbf N$ and $N$ is an $S$-submodule of $S^n$. The equivalence relation identifies two pairs $(n,N)$ when their quotient modules are $S$-linearly isomorphic. For $a,b\in I_S$, write $a\oplus b$ for the class of the direct sum of their quotient modules (represented by $S^{n+m}/(N\oplus N')$ under the standard coordinate identification). Using the presented abelian group [def-trf-abelian-group-presentation], take $I=I_S$, $J=I_S\times I_S$, and $r(a,b)=e_a+e_b-e_{a\oplus b}$; define $K_0(S)=G(I,J,r)$. For a finite projective module $Q$, $[Q]$ is the coset of the generator for its isomorphism class.
